character.name: Yorin Vask
character.background: Foundling of the Hushed Nock — sniper initiate
traits: Sneak Attack: once per turn, extra 1d6 damage against surprised or distracted foes
Thieves' Cant: secret rogue language of signs, marks, and slang
Still Breath: trained by snipers to slow heartbeat and silence movement
character.gear: Hush-nock longbow · quiver of black-fletched arrows · sparrow-hide leather jerkin · bone lockpicks in a crow-foot case · dried raven meat · grave-sap healing draught · waxed signal whistle · oiled bedroll
character.story: Left in a salt-stained basket at the gate of the Hushed Nock, Yorin was raised by masked archers who taught him to count heartbeats before he could count years. He believes he was unwanted. He is wrong. The night he loosed his first arrow, a distant crown cracked in its hall, and the order's elders began watching him with knives beneath their prayers. Something old sleeps in his blood, a power that can unseat kings or break the world's hinge. Yorin only knows the bow has always whispered names he has never met.

inventory.name: Hush-nock longbow
inventory.lore: Carved from gallows-yew grown in the Ashen Cloisters and strung with a braid taken from an oathbreaker. The order says it has drunk the last breath of sentries on the Saltglass Wall.
inventory.description: A black longbow used by the Hushed Nock for silent, long-distance killing.

inventory.name: Quiver of black-fletched arrows
inventory.lore: Each shaft was cut from funeral pines and fletched with crow feathers during a moonless vigil. The arrowheads bear the order's closed-eye stamp.
inventory.description: A quiver holding twenty black arrows.

inventory.name: Sparrow-hide leather jerkin
inventory.lore: Sewn from the hides of sparrows taken by the order's first masters, though no living bird gave them willingly. It still smells of rain and old fear.
inventory.description: Light leather protection worn beneath a cloak.

inventory.name: Bone lockpicks in a crow-foot case
inventory.lore: Ground from the knuckles of a nameless saint and kept in a case stitched from crow skin. They open more than doors when the order's rites demand it.
inventory.description: Thieves' tools fashioned from bone picks, tension bars, and a crow-foot case.

inventory.name: Dried raven meat
inventory.lore: Cured in the bell-towers of the Hushed Nock where the wind never stops whispering. Initiates eat it before their first watch, so hunger learns to keep silent.
inventory.description: Three strips of tough, smoke-cured raven meat.

inventory.name: Grave-sap healing draught
inventory.lore: Tapped from roots that grow through buried crowns and sealed in red wax by the order's blind apothecary. It tastes of iron and forgiven sins.
inventory.description: A small vial of thick red liquid used to close wounds.

inventory.name: Waxed signal whistle
inventory.lore: Carved from a traitor's finger-bone and sealed with black wax. Its note carries across rooftops, but only ears trained by the order can hear it clearly.
inventory.description: A small whistle used for coded sniper signals.

inventory.name: Oiled bedroll
inventory.lore: Stitched from sailcloth taken from a ghostless ship and rubbed with lamp oil to shed rain. Yorin has slept in it every night since the order gave him a roof.
inventory.description: A weatherproof bedroll for long watches and hidden camps.
